about: DRAFT, never run. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B (NVIDIA's 24 GB safetensors checkpoint) with NVIDIA's LiLiCorr drafter on TensorFold's Zig engine plus Mia's Bolt backend (MiaAI-Lab/Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-TensorFold-DGX-Spark@6f61d772, TensorFold 46a08c18, patches 5e11cf1ed295). Mia's published image for that exact hash: linux/arm64 only, one v2 manifest, AOT sm121 kernels, built 2026-10-16. Mia's start.sh runs it with --ipc=host --network host --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864 and a writable kernel cache at /cache; this launch drops all four (the plugin allows none of them) and keeps HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Parallel 4 instead of Mia's 16 and prompt cache 4 GiB instead of 8, for the desktop beside it. On one DGX Spark Mia measured 71.0 tok/s prose / 114.1 tok/s code for one request, 166.6 tok/s for 8, prefill 1,375 tok/s at 32K, 51.1 GB loaded with 16 streams.

plugin.name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B
plugin.format: safetensors · NVIDIA 24 GB (IQ2_XXS / NVFP4 / Q8_0) + LiLiCorr

setup: Revisions are Mia's pins (the later Hub commits c6cc2e8f / abd47806 only touch README.md and explainability.md); the recipe's contract/bolt.json checks the checkpoint. ~25 GB of downloads (24.12 GB checkpoint + 0.96 GB drafter) plus the 11.4 GB image. Two things to prove before this can leave drafts: (1) that the engine runs without --ulimit stack=67108864, --ipc=host and a writable /cache (CUDA_CACHE_PATH=/cache/nv lands in the container layer instead); (2) provenance: the image is pushed by hand (scripts/publish-image.sh), with no build attestation, so lab/export_plugin.py's NO_PROVENANCE rule means it needs an attested rebuild of the same Dockerfile (nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3 base, Zig 0.17.0) before the plugin is handed it.
